implementationRevision: 930128e (chore/goz-0000-bootstrap; corrective commit 3273724; demo re-run recorded at b4d82e1 on a clean tree, 930128e adds only evidence). Initial analysis at e7904ad.

findings.title: GOZ-0000 boundary tests will intentionally fail as product surfaces arrive
evidence: tests/Gozleme.Api.IntegrationTests/BootstrapBoundaryTests.cs:22-38 asserts 404 for /api/v1/catalog, /api/v1/capabilities, /api/v1/organizations, /api/v1/users, /api/v1/search?q=mcp, POST /api/v1/auth/login, POST /api/v1/publish, /login
tests/Gozleme.Api.IntegrationTests/BootstrapBoundaryTests.cs:40-57 asserts zero tables in schema gozleme and only public.__EFMigrationsHistory
e2e/tests/bootstrap-demo.spec.ts:102-120 asserts 404s, /login,/catalog,/organizations pages 404, no links and no 'sign in' text on /
Every future prompt requires 'Keep existing demos and smoke tests working'
findings.recommendation: Each spec introducing one of these surfaces narrows only the assertions it supersedes, keeps the rest, and adds its own boundary test; never delete or weaken the suite wholesale.

findings.title: Anonymous status/health surfaces and container healthchecks versus GOZ-0001 protected dashboard
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/GozlemeApp.cs:40-47 maps /health/live, /health/ready, /api/v1/status with no authentication
web/src/app/page.tsx renders StatusDashboard at /; web/src/app/api/backend-status/route.ts proxies server-side via GOZLEME_API_URL
compose.yaml:53 api healthcheck uses /health/live; compose.yaml:73 web healthcheck fetches /api/backend-status
deploy/helm/gozleme/templates/api.yaml:34-39 liveness/readiness probes on /health/live and /health/ready
e2e/tests/bootstrap-demo.spec.ts healthy/degraded/recovery/unreachable scenarios browse / anonymously
findings.recommendation: GOZ-0001 keeps /health/* anonymous, decides and documents whether the status dashboard and /api/v1/status become authenticated, and keeps container healthchecks and the four GOZ-0000 demo scenarios passing (sign in with a seeded synthetic account if protected). Session design must fit the same-origin Next.js route-handler pattern.

findings.title: Role, ownership and default-privilege facts; no RLS or tenant context yet; app role can set arbitrary GUCs
evidence: deploy/postgres/init/01-roles.sh:16-21 gozleme_migrator NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS owns database; gozleme_app NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOBYPASSRLS NOINHERIT

src/Gozleme.Api/Persistence/Migrations/20261114000000_Foundation.cs:18-24 creates schema gozleme and ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES granting SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all future tables to gozleme_app
Live stack: pg_default_acl shows gozleme_app=arwd/gozleme_migrator and rU on sequences; schema gozleme owned by gozleme_migrator
Live stack (rolled-back transaction): SET ROLE gozleme_app; SET LOCAL app.tenant_id = 'x' succeeds
No RLS policy, tenant column or tenant-context code exists at e7904ad
findings.recommendation: Tenant-owned tables enable RLS and policies in the same migration that creates them; GOZ-0003 decides FORCE RLS explicitly (migrator owns all tables), adds a catalog test for relrowsecurity, retrofits GOZ-0001/0002 tables, and treats the tenant GUC as defence in depth only.

findings.title: Default privileges grant UPDATE/DELETE on every future table, including those that must be immutable or append-only
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Persistence/Migrations/20261114000000_Foundation.cs:21
docs/architecture/security-invariants.md invariant 6 (immutable signed publications)
findings.recommendation: Creating migrations for immutable/append-only tables REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE from gozleme_app (or enforce equivalently) and prove database-level rejection with an integration test as gozleme_app.

findings.title: pgvector cannot be created by the migrator role; pg_trgm can
evidence: Live stack: /usr/share/postgresql/17/extension/vector.control (default_version 0.8.6) has no 'trusted = true'
Live stack (rolled-back transaction): SET ROLE gozleme_migrator; CREATE EXTENSION vector -> ERROR permission denied to create extension "vector", HINT Must be superuser
Live stack (rolled-back transaction): SET ROLE gozleme_migrator; CREATE EXTENSION pg_trgm SCHEMA gozleme succeeds (pg_trgm.control trusted = true)
src/Gozleme.Api/Status/DatabaseProbe.cs:22-27 vector.available = pg_available_extensions, vector.enabled = pg_extension
tests/Gozleme.Api.IntegrationTests/OptionalVectorTests.cs proves health on postgres:17-alpine
findings.recommendation: GOZ-0015 provides an operator/superuser provisioning step for vector (opt-in Compose init script, Helm prerequisite), keeps vector objects conditional, and exposes semantic-search state separately from vector.enabled via contract revision. Granting superuser to either application role requires human approval and is not recommended.

findings.title: Status contract v1 extension rules for new dependencies
evidence: docs/specs/000-repository-bootstrap/contracts/status-api.openapi.yaml: ServiceStatus and DependencyStatus additionalProperties false; dependency status enum healthy|unavailable
src/Gozleme.Api/Status/StatusService.cs:24-25 degraded only when a required dependency is unhealthy
web/src/lib/status.ts:42-74 strict structural validation; unknown shapes become invalid-response
Re-analysis at 930128e: prompt text for 0009/0010/0011/0015/0016 updated to reflect the corrected validator tolerance
findings.recommendation: Add new dependencies as dependencies[] entries, optional providers with required:false; any new field or status value is a contract revision updating OpenAPI, web validator and tests together.

findings.title: Web status validator is stricter than the OpenAPI contract for capabilities
evidence: docs/specs/000-repository-bootstrap/contracts/status-api.openapi.yaml: capabilities is object|null with optional property vector (no required list)
web/src/lib/status.ts:44-50 rejects any non-null capabilities lacking a valid vector object, so a contract-valid {} renders as invalid-response/unreachable

Re-analysis at 930128e: web/src/lib/status.ts isDependency now accepts capabilities null or an object whose vector is absent or a valid {available,enabled}; status.test.ts adds 'accepts capabilities without the optional vector entry' and a malformed-vector rejection case; StatusDashboard.tsx:56 already uses optional chaining; typecheck and 18 Vitest tests pass at HEAD
findings.recommendation: Corrective change in GOZ-0000: either mark vector required inside capabilities in the OpenAPI, or relax isDependency to accept capabilities objects where vector is absent or valid; add a Vitest case for the chosen rule.

findings.title: Demo runner and evidence layout are hard-coded to GOZ-0000; no seed mechanism
evidence: scripts/demo/run-demo.sh:8 SPEC_DIR=docs/specs/000-repository-bootstrap; :41 --spec GOZ-0000
e2e/tests/bootstrap-demo.spec.ts:10 hard-coded screenshot directory
.github/workflows/ci.yml:98-99 e2e-demo runs scripts/demo/run-demo.sh
Makefile:56-57 demo target documents GOZ-0000 evidence path
docs/engineering/demo-contract.md requires deterministic seeded data; no seed command exists
findings.recommendation: GOZ-0001 generalizes the runner to a spec parameter writing docs/specs/<spec-dir>/evidence, runs prior suites cumulatively, and introduces one deterministic synthetic seed path separate from schema migrations.

findings.title: Reusable Testcontainers fixture defaults to superuser, which would silently bypass RLS
evidence: tests/Gozleme.Api.IntegrationTests/Infrastructure/GozlemeDatabase.cs:30-62 applies 01-roles.sh then the real migrator; exposes Superuser/Migrator/App connection strings
tests/Gozleme.Api.IntegrationTests/Infrastructure/GozlemeDatabase.cs:70 ScalarAsync defaults to SuperuserConnectionString
tests/Gozleme.Api.IntegrationTests/Infrastructure/Fixtures.cs:3 assembly-wide shared PgvectorDatabaseFixture
findings.recommendation: Reuse the fixture; isolation and leak tests must use AppConnectionString or the API; mutating tests use isolated data or their own database.

findings.title: Migration mechanism, single host project and out-of-band role creation
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Persistence/GozlemeDbContext.cs (no entities), MigrationRunner.cs (migrate command, GozlemeMigrator connection string)
compose.yaml:27-40 one-shot migrate service; api depends_on service_completed_successfully
deploy/helm/gozleme/templates/migrate-job.yaml:10 pre-install,pre-upgrade hook (old pods still serve during upgrade)
deploy/postgres/init/01-roles.sh runs only on a fresh volume; migrator NOCREATEROLE
deploy/helm/gozleme/README.md roles are an operator prerequisite
findings.recommendation: New tables via new EF migrations in schema gozleme, never migrate on API start-up, keep migrations backward compatible for pre-upgrade; any new DB role goes into 01-roles.sh and the Helm README with make reset locally; establish module layout only as needed.

findings.title: OpenTelemetry has no owning spec
evidence: docs/architecture/technology-stack.md lists OpenTelemetry as part of the stack
docs/specs/000-repository-bootstrap/research.md R9 defers OpenTelemetry to 'the operational spec that needs traces/metrics'
No prompt in docs/prompts/spec-0001.md..spec-0039.md mentions OpenTelemetry, tracing or metrics
src/Gozleme.Api/GozlemeApp.cs:18-23 JSON console logging only
findings.recommendation: Human decides ownership: add OpenTelemetry (with secret-free trace attributes per invariant 8) to an existing MVP spec such as GOZ-0039, or record it as post-MVP. No prompt edited.

findings.title: Protected main not applied or verified (security invariant 12)
evidence: docs/specs/000-repository-bootstrap/research.md R8: rulesets and branch protection APIs return HTTP 403 on this private repository plan
docs/specs/000-repository-bootstrap/progress.yaml blocker GOZ-0000-B1
docs/engineering/github-protection.md status NOT VERIFIED
findings.recommendation: Human owner enables rulesets (plan upgrade or public visibility), applies the documented ruleset and records verification. No future-prompt change; every spec's completion still depends on verified human merge.

findings.title: Deployment conventions: Secret references, read-only root filesystem, Compose service conventions
evidence: deploy/helm/gozleme/values.yaml:13-16 database.existingSecret with app-connection-string and migrator-connection-string keys
deploy/helm/gozleme/values.yaml:41-44 readOnlyRootFilesystem true; templates/api.yaml:44-48 only /tmp emptyDir
compose.yaml ports bound to 127.0.0.1 with GOZLEME_* overrides; .env.example throwaway defaults
deploy/helm/gozleme/README.md:3-5 chart never installed on a live cluster
findings.recommendation: New secrets use Secret references by name; Data Protection keys (GOZ-0001) and filesystem artifacts (GOZ-0009) need durable explicit storage, not the container filesystem; optional emulators/providers join Compose without changing the base stack; GOZ-0039 performs a live Helm install/upgrade per CR-14.

findings.title: No local two-instance harness for federation demos
evidence: compose.yaml:1 name: gozleme; compose.yaml:80-81 single pgdata volume
e2e/tests/compose.ts:7-9 docker compose invoked without a project flag
.env.example GOZLEME_WEB_PORT/GOZLEME_API_PORT/GOZLEME_DB_PORT overrides exist
findings.recommendation: GOZ-0029 establishes a reusable two-instance harness (distinct project names and ports, project-aware e2e helper); later federation specs reuse it.

findings.title: Backup/restore must recreate out-of-band roles
evidence: deploy/postgres/init/01-roles.sh creates cluster-level roles outside migrations
Database-level pg_dump does not include roles
findings.recommendation: Restore procedure recreates gozleme_migrator/gozleme_app before restore and verifies NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS afterwards.

findings.title: InvariantGlobalization is enabled
evidence: Directory.Build.props: InvariantGlobalization true
findings.recommendation: GOZ-0005 keeps ID/namespace normalization ordinal/invariant and tests any Unicode/IDN behavior under this setting; changing it must be explicit.

findings.title: research.md R7 does not match the implemented CI
evidence: docs/specs/000-repository-bootstrap/research.md:38 lists a 'containers' job and actions pinned by major version tag
.github/workflows/ci.yml has no containers job (images are built inside e2e-demo) and pins every action by commit SHA
Re-analysis at 930128e: research.md R7 now lists the actual jobs, states there is no containers job (images built in e2e-demo) and SHA pinning
findings.recommendation: Corrective doc edit in GOZ-0000 research.md R7 to describe the actual jobs and SHA pinning.

findings.title: Compiled Python cache tracked in git
evidence: git ls-files lists scripts/__pycache__/generate_register.cpython-313.pyc (added in 455d192, before this spec)
.gitignore:33-34 ignores __pycache__/ and *.pyc
Re-analysis at 930128e: git ls-files scripts/__pycache__ returns nothing at HEAD
findings.recommendation: git rm --cached -r scripts/__pycache__ on the GOZ-0000 branch.

findings.title: No JavaScript dependency vulnerability check in CI
evidence: docs/engineering/ci-quality-gates.md requires 'code secret scanning and dependency checks'
.github/workflows/ci.yml has gitleaks but no pnpm audit or dependency-review step; .NET relies on SDK-default NuGet audit plus TreatWarningsAsErrors (Directory.Build.props), not explicitly configured

Re-analysis at 930128e: ci.yml frontend job runs 'pnpm audit --prod --audit-level low'; Directory.Build.props sets NuGetAudit true, NuGetAuditMode all, NuGetAuditLevel low and NU1901-NU1904 as errors. Downstream note: any spec adding a NuGet or production npm package now fails CI on any published advisory, including low severity; future specs must resolve or explicitly and documentedly suppress, never silently disable the audit
findings.recommendation: Add a pnpm audit (or dependency-review) step and set NuGetAudit/NuGetAuditMode explicitly; non-blocking for FR-015, which does not list dependency checks.
